name: Beginnings
q: A journey of a thousand miles starts with one step
Even three days is still a start
Isn't learning and practice a joy
Chance favors only the prepared mind
You regret what you never tried
Knowing starts it; doing completes it
A great tree grows from a small sprout
On a circle, the beginning and the end are one
The beginnings of all things are small
All make a start; few reach the end
The future enters us before it happens
The greatest things under heaven are done in what is small
